name: Visit Ollie
description: Ollie seems to need help. Head over to his house and see what's going on.

start.text: Kiki! I'm so glad you're here. I have a favour to ask.
I had a feeling. What's up?
Wally at the fish shop has a delivery for the bakery, but he can't leave. Could you pick it up and run it over?
Sure, sounds simple enough.
An arrow will point you where to go. Pick up the fish, then follow it to the bakery. Cats around town will always need your help, and they'll pay for it!
One more thing, at any time press Q to see all of your active tasks. Good luck, Kiki!

complete.text: Ah, the morning fish! Wonderful. Wally sends the best. Thank you, Kiki!
Happy to help.
You did it! See? That's all there is to it.
That wasn't so hard.
Now that you've got the hang of it, I am sure there is no shortage of work!

name: Fresh Fish Delivery
description: Pick up the fresh fish from the fish shop and bring it to the bakery.

start.text: Hey there! I just caught some fresh fish and I need someone to deliver it to the bakery. Can you help me out?
Sure, I can do that!
Great! Just pick up the fish from the fish shop and bring it to the bakery. Thanks!

complete.text: Kiki! Fresh fish from Wally — you're a treasure. I can get started on the lunch menu straight away.
No problem! Happy to help.

name: Catnip Run
description: Pick up the catnip from the beach house and bring it to the hospital.

start.text: Hey there! The hospital needs catnip urgently. Big Chungus has some at his place. Can you pick it up?
Sure, I can do that!
Great! Grab the catnip from the beach house and bring it straight to the hospital. Thanks!

complete.text: Catnip from the beach house. Good quality. This is exactly what we needed.
No problem! Happy to help.

name: Midnight Snack
description: Ollie has the munchies. Grab a fish from the shop and bring it back to him.

start.text: Kiki! I've got the worst case of the midnight munchies. Could you run to the fish shop and grab me a nice fresh fish?
It's the middle of the day, Ollie...
Don't judge me. Just get the fish, please!

complete.text: Oh wow, that smells amazing! You're the best, Kiki!
Try to leave some for tomorrow, please.

name: Rescue Mr. Whiskers
description: Ollie's toy mouse rolled into the haunted house. Someone has to go get it.

start.text: Kiki, have you seen Mr. Whiskers? My toy mouse! I think it rolled into the haunted house and I'm too scared to go get it.
You named your toy mouse Mr. Whiskers?
He has a very distinguished personality. Will you please go get him?

complete.text: Mr. Whiskers! You're safe! Thank you so much, Kiki, I was so worried.
He was just sitting by the front door. I don't think the haunted house is actually haunted.
Kiki, please don't ruin this for me.

name: Catnip Cookies
description: Bakercat is baking catnip cookies but needs a fresh supply from the hospital.

start.text: Hello! I'm baking a special batch of catnip cookies today but I've run out of catnip. The hospital keeps some in their supply room.
You're baking with medical catnip?
It's the finest grade! Only the best for my cookies. Could you fetch some from the hospital and bring it to the bakery?

complete.text: Perfect! These cookies are going to be legendary. Here, take one as thanks!
Oh, these are actually really good!
Of course they are. I'm a professional.

name: Lost Package
description: A package at the post office never got delivered to Moe at the beach. Take it over.

start.text: Kiki! This package has been sitting on the shelf for three weeks. It's addressed to Moe.
Did you just... not deliver it?
I got distracted! Can you take it over to the beach house for me? Please?

complete.text: Oh hey. My package. I forgot I was even expecting something.
It's been at the post office for three weeks.
Hm. That tracks. Thanks Kiki, you're solid.

name: Forward the Package
description: Turns out the package was meant for the school. Moe asks you to bring the book over.

start.text: Oh hey Kiki. That package Jake sent? It's actually a book for the school. Total mixup.
So you've had the school's book for three weeks?
I didn't open it! Well. I opened it. But I didn't read it. Much. Can you bring it over?

complete.text: The library book! We have been waiting on this for quite some time. Where has it been?
It took a slight detour via Moe's house.
I see. Well, it is here now. Thank you, Kiki.

name: School Receipt
description: Ms. Violet needs to send a receipt back to the post office confirming the book arrived.

start.text: Kiki, we finally received our missing library book. Only three weeks late!
I may have had something to do with that.
Could you bring this signed receipt to Jake at the post office? Closure is important.

complete.text: A signed receipt! Oh wonderful, I can finally close this file. It's only been three weeks.
Glad it's sorted, Jake.

name: Wizard Needs Fish
description: Cornelius is working on a new spell and urgently needs a fresh fish from the shop.

start.text: ... grumble grumble...        Oh. Kiki. Good. I require a fresh fish. From the shop. Immediately.
What's the fish for?
Spell components. Do not ask follow-up questions. Please.

complete.text: Good. Yes. This will do. The experiment continues.
You're welcome, Cornelius.

name: Wizard Needs Catnip
description: The first ingredient worked. Now Cornelius needs catnip from the hospital to finish his spell.

start.text: Phase one: complete. Now I require catnip. The hospital keeps pharmaceutical grade. Fetch it.
Is this spell dangerous?
Statistically? Probably not. Go.

complete.text: Excellent. The mixture reacts correctly. One final component remains.
There's a final component.

name: Enchanted Bread
description: Cornelius accidentally enchanted a loaf of bread. He wants Miroslav to taste-test it.

start.text: The spell... worked. Mostly. It produced bread. Enchanted bread. I cannot eat it myself.
You accidentally baked bread?
I deliberately produced an edible arcane byproduct. Bring it to Miroslav. For analysis.

complete.text: This bread is glowing, Kiki. Why is it glowing?
Cornelius made it. He called it an arcane byproduct. For analysis.
...It tastes incredible. I need to speak with that wizard.

name: Apples for the Kids
description: Dr. Meow wants Moe's donated apples brought to the school for the students.

start.text: Kiki! Moe donated a batch of apples as part of our community health drive. Could you collect them and bring them to the school?
Sure. A for effort from Moe.
Indeed. The children could use the vitamins.

complete.text: Oh, the donation from Dr. Meow! Perfect timing. The children are just about to have their break.
He said they could use the vitamins.
He is quite right. Thank you, Kiki.

name: Medicine Supply Run
description: A few students ate too many apples. Dr. Meow needs medicine brought to the school fast.

start.text: Kiki. Those apples I sent to the school. Apparently the children ate ALL of them in one sitting.
That does sound like kids.
I need you to bring this medicine to the school. Quickly please.

complete.text: You made it! Right, hand those over. I have seven very sorry little cats in the hall.
No apples next time?
No apples next time. That is now school policy.

name: Health Certificate
description: Ms. Violet is sending a health report back to Dr. Meow for his records.

start.text: Kiki, I've written up a full health incident report from today's apple situation. Dr. Meow requested it for his records.
You wrote an incident report about kids eating too many apples?
Documentation is important, Kiki. Could you bring it to the hospital please?

complete.text: The incident report. Good. I will add it to the apple file.
She also noted a request that future donations be pre-portioned.
Noted. I have already updated the protocol.

name: Overdue Book
description: Ollie has had a library book checked out for months. Marigold wants it back.

start.text: Kiki! Just the cat I wanted to see. Ollie still has 'The Complete History of Napping' checked out. It's been four months.
I'll be honest, I'm not surprised.
Could you pick it up from his place and bring it back? I have a waiting list!

complete.text: Finally! And it is in perfect condition. I suppose he really did read it cover to cover.
He had dog-eared at least forty pages.

name: Recipe Book Recommendation
description: While reshelving, Marigold found a recipe book Miroslav would love. Deliver it to the bakery.

start.text: Oh Kiki, perfect timing. While reshelving I found this old recipe book, 'Ancient Cat Cuisine.' Miroslav would adore it.
You're giving away a library book?
It's a duplicate copy! Would you bring it to the bakery for me?

complete.text: 'Ancient Cat Cuisine!' Kiki, do you know how rare this volume is? I have been looking for a copy for years.
Marigold said it was a duplicate. Happy to pass it on.
A gift? Extraordinary. Excuse me, I need to read this immediately.

name: Bait Run
description: Wally needs bread from the bakery to use as bait for the big fishing contest.

start.text: Kiki! There's a fishing contest today and my secret bait is bread crumbs. I need a fresh loaf from Miroslav.
You're using bread as bait?
Don't knock it 'til you've tried it. First place, every time. Grab me a loaf, will you?

complete.text: Perfect! Now we wait. The fish will come to me. They always do.
You look very confident for someone using sandwich ingredients.

name: Contest Prize
description: Wally won the fishing contest! He wants to donate his trophy to the school's display case.

start.text: Kiki! I won! First place, biggest catch, just like every year. The prize is a little trophy.
Congratulations Wally! Are you keeping it?
I've got a shelf full. Would you bring this one to the school's trophy case? The kids love that stuff.

complete.text: A trophy from Wally! For the display case! How generous. The students will be very inspired.
He has a shelf full, apparently.
I shall give a speech about dedication and perseverance.

name: Pool Snacks
description: Tammy needs a fresh loaf of bread from the bakery for the swimmers' snack break.

start.text: Kiki! I forgot to pick up snacks for the afternoon swim session. Could you grab a loaf of bread from Miroslav?
Sure. How many swimmers are we feeding?
Six. But honestly, I might eat half of it myself. It's been a long shift.

complete.text: Perfect timing, they just got out of the water. You're a star, Kiki!
Don't forget to eat some yourself.

name: Ollie's Sweet Tooth
description: Ollie has been craving ice cream all morning. Make a run to the bakery for him.

start.text: Kiki, I have been thinking about ice cream since I woke up. I cannot stop. It's a medical emergency.
It really isn't.
Emotionally it is! Please, one scoop from Miroslav. I'll owe you forever.

complete.text: OH. This is everything. This is the best day of my life.
You said that yesterday about the fish.

name: Under the Weather
description: Ollie isn't feeling well and needs medicine from the hospital quickly.

start.text: Kiki... I don't feel so good. Could you run to the hospital and get me some medicine?
What happened? Did you eat too much fish again?
...That is not relevant right now. Please hurry.

complete.text: Thank you. I feel a tiny bit better already.
Next time maybe stop at two fish.

name: Offering Apple
description: Cornelius needs an apple from the beach house for an obscure arcane ritual.

start.text: The ritual requires an apple. Specifically from the beach. Something about the salt air. Don't ask.
I wasn't going to ask.
Moe usually has some. Fetch one and bring it here before the moon shifts.

complete.text: Yes. This has the right resonance. The ritual may proceed.
Great. Happy to help with the ritual.

name: Bread Donation
description: Miroslav baked extra and wants to donate a fresh loaf to the hospital patients.

start.text: Kiki! I had an inspired baking session this morning and made far too much bread. The patients at the hospital deserve a treat.
That's really kind of you, Miroslav.
Kindness is an ingredient! Would you take a loaf over for me?

complete.text: Bread from the bakery. Fresh. Good crust. This will do very nicely for the patients.
Miroslav used a new recipe. Extra fluffy, he said.
It is... adequate. You may tell him that.

name: Swim Manual
description: Tammy needs a swimming technique book from the library for a new training class.

start.text: Kiki! I'm starting an advanced swimming class next week and I need the stroke technique manual from the library.
Marigold should have that.
She always does. Could you pick it up and bring it here? I need to review before tomorrow.

complete.text: Yes! This is exactly it. Chapter seven alone is going to revolutionise my class.
Chapter seven about the backstroke?
The backstroke mindset. Very different.

name: Melting Fast
description: Miroslav made a special beach order. The ice cream needs to get there before it melts!

start.text: Kiki! Moe ordered ice cream and I just scooped it. You need to run, it'll melt if you're not quick!
How fast?
Very fast. Go go go!

complete.text: Ice cream from Miroslav. Is it... still good?
It was mostly intact.
Mostly works for me. You're a legend, Kiki.

name: Letter for Ollie
description: Jake finally found Ollie's missing letter. It's been at the post office for weeks.

start.text: Kiki! Great news. I found that letter I mentioned to Ollie months ago. It was under a pile of forms. Could you deliver it?
Months ago?
Filing systems are a process. Will you take it to him?

complete.text: A letter? For me? Oh! I remember now — I was expecting this months ago!
It was at the post office the whole time.
Jake. Only Jake. Well — thank you for getting it to me, Kiki.

name: Spooked Toy
description: A toy washed up near the haunted house. Tammy wants it for pool activities.

start.text: Kiki, someone reported a toy washed up near the haunted house. It'd be great for the pool's diving exercises.
Near the haunted house.
It's just a building, Kiki. Could you grab it?

complete.text: This is perfect! The little ones will love diving for this.
For the record, there were definitely weird noises in there.
Old pipes. Carry on.

name: Doctor's Apple
description: Ms. Violet has apples left over from a class project. Dr. Meow wants them for patients.

start.text: Kiki! Ms. Violet has leftover apples from a science experiment. I'd like to use them for our vitamin programme.
I thought you didn't like apples?
I don't eat them. Patients are different. Could you collect them from the school?

complete.text: Excellent. These will be distributed at afternoon rounds.
Ms. Violet said they're very nutritious. She had charts.

name: Science Class Catnip
description: Ms. Violet is running a biology lesson and needs a catnip sample from the hospital.

start.text: Kiki! I'm doing a plant biology lesson tomorrow and I'd love to use catnip as the specimen. The hospital has proper samples.
Are you sure using catnip in a classroom is a good idea?
We are professionals. The children will remain composed. Probably. Could you fetch some?

complete.text: Wonderful! The lesson will be very hands-on. And nose-on, I suppose.
Good luck maintaining order.

name: Jake's Lunch
description: Jake got so busy sorting mail that he forgot his lunch. Grab him a loaf from the bakery.

start.text: Kiki, I am absolutely starving. I was so busy this morning I didn't even stop for breakfast.
Jake, it's nearly three in the afternoon.
Could you please grab something from Miroslav? Anything. I'm desperate.

complete.text: Oh thank goodness. You are a wonderful person, Kiki.
Please eat regularly, Jake.

name: Beach House Blues
description: Moe caught a summer cold. He needs medicine from the hospital.

start.text: Hey Kiki. Don't come too close. I've got a cold. Very uncool.
A summer cold? That's rough, Moe.
Could you grab me some medicine from the hospital? I can barely get off the couch.

complete.text: Thanks. You're a real one, Kiki.
Rest up. Drink water.
Already on it. Stay frosty.

name: Ollie's Letter
description: Ollie finally wrote a letter he's been putting off. Take it to the post office for him.

start.text: Kiki! I finally wrote my letter. It only took me six weeks. Could you take it to Jake at the post office?
Six weeks, Ollie?
It had to be perfect. I did seven drafts.

complete.text: A letter from Ollie! Oh, how exciting. I will get it processed immediately. Or... soon. Relatively soon.
He spent six weeks on it. Seven drafts.
Then it deserves to be handled with care. Absolutely.

name: Wizard's Fish Order
description: Cornelius put in a standing order for weekly fish. Wally needs someone to run the delivery.

start.text: Kiki! Cornelius put in a weekly fish order and I can't leave the shop. Could you run this one up to the tower?
What does he need fish for every week?
He pays well and doesn't ask for discounts. That's enough for me.

complete.text: The weekly fish. Good. Set it there. You may go.
Wally says hello.
...Noted.

name: Stress Relief
description: Ollie is having a stressful day and really needs catnip from the hospital to calm down.

start.text: Kiki. Everything is going wrong. I knocked over my water bowl, I lost my favourite cushion, and I can't nap. I need catnip.
That does sound awful, Ollie.
The hospital has some. Please hurry. I am unravelling.

complete.text: Oh. Oh that's better. Everything is fine. Everything is wonderful.
Glad to hear it. Try not to knock anything else over.

name: Library Book Sale
description: Marigold is hosting a book sale and needs bread from the bakery to feed the visitors.

start.text: Kiki! I'm holding a charity book sale this afternoon and I thought refreshments would encourage browsing.
That's a lovely idea.
Would you pick up a loaf from Miroslav? Readers read better on a full stomach, I always say.

complete.text: Perfect! I'll slice it up. We've already had three visitors and it's not even started yet.
I think the bread might be the bigger draw than the books.
Whatever gets them through the door.
